subject: Helios MAP: ramp incentives & approval path
messages:
From: Alex Owens <alex.owens@helios-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lina Park <lina.park@helios-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP proposal + ask: ramp incentives for Q3 pilot

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the demo last week. Lina and I reviewed internally and we want to push a 3-month pilot around our customer-experience models. High level: 500k tokens/month average in month 1, ramp to 2.5M tokens/month by month 3 if latency and output quality hold up.

We liked Redwood’s MAP template (attached); two asks to make this workable for procurement:
- A limited ramp discount (we're proposing 25% off list for months 2–3, tied to achieving a joint milestone checklist)
- A defined credit if SLOs (p99 latency < 300ms) are missed for more than 2 business days in a billing month

Can you confirm whether the ramp discount can be approved at the AE/Director level or whether we need higher sign-off? We’d like to get to an LOI by the end of next week so we can start the pilot 6/1.

Attached: Helios_MAP_v1.pdf (PDF) — draft MAP, and a proposed PRICING_TABLE.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Owens
Head of ML Platforms, Helios Analytics
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Owens <alex.owens@helios-analytics.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP proposal + ask: ramp incentives for Q3 pilot

Alex —

Appreciate the clear asks and the MAP draft. Quick answers: we can operate a conditional ramp discount but anything above 15% requires a formal approval path (VP+ or finance depending on net ARR commit). I’m looping in Soojin (solutions lead) to confirm the milestone checklist, and Laura from pricing to advise approval thresholds.

We’ll review the MAP and return a redline by EOD tomorrow. If Helios can commit to a minimum 12-month renewal at demonstrated ramp, that will help accelerate internal approval.

Proposed next steps:
- Our team to return a redline of the MAP by 04/21 EOD
- Joint milestone doc finalized by 04/23
- LOI draft for signature by 04/30 (goal)

Thanks — we’ll try to keep this lightweight.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Owens <alex.owens@helios-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP proposal + ask: ramp incentives for Q3 pilot

Ben / Laura —

Quick read on the MAP attached. I tightened the milestone language and added clear measurement windows for latency and quality gates. Notes:
- Milestone A (end of month 1): deploy to integration environment + baseline eval (throughput and NPS-like quality gauge)
- Milestone B (end of month 2): 95% of calls under p99 300ms during peak; sample-based quality pass rate >= 92% for Helios test set
- Ramp discount: proposing a tiered approach — 10% in month 2, 15% in month 3 if Milestone B met; additional 10% discretionary credit (not applied retroactively) if we miss SLOs more than threshold

I’ll add suggested language for approval: anything >15% total recurring discount needs sign-off from VP Sales + CFO. Attach redlined MAP.

-Sooj
Sooj
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: FWD: Helios MAP (redline) — asking for discount approval path

FYI — forwarding the MAP redline and Helios asks. High level: Helios requests a 25% ramp discount contingent on milestones; Sooj proposed tiered 10%/15% (month2/month3) and flagged anything >15% recurring requires VP + CFO sign-off. Helios wants an LOI by 04/30 to start 06/01.

Could you weigh in on whether we can approve up to 15% here, and if finance would consider a conditional credit arrangement for SLO misses? If you approve, we’ll present a final MAP and LOI drafts to Helios.

Attachments: Helios_MAP_v1_redline.pdf, Proposed_PRICING_TABLE.xlsx

—Ben
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FWD: Helios MAP (redline) — asking for discount approval path

Ben —

I’m comfortable approving a combined ramp discount up to 15% if the customer signs the 12-month revenue commitment we discussed and we include the SLO credit language as a capped, one-time credit (not recurring). Finance should weigh in on the credit cap; my recommendation is a maximum service credit equal to 2 weeks of expected spend for the pilot period if SLOs are missed per the thresholds Sooj outlined.

Aditya, Marcus — pls confirm finance comfort with the service credit cap and whether we need CFO sign-off for the 15% or only for larger discounts/credits. If we require CFO sign-off, Ben — please let Helios know there may be a 48-hour escalation window for final approval after LOI is signed.

-Laura
VP, Commercial Pricing
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FWD: Helios MAP (redline) — asking for discount approval path

Ben / team —

Finance is okay with the proposed path: up to 15% total ramp discount approved at VP/pricing level provided there is a signed 12-month commitment and the service-credit cap is limited to two weeks of pilot spend (as a one-time credit). Anything that creates a recurring >15% effective discount or a credit exposure > 2 weeks spend needs CFO sign-off.

If you get Helios to accept those constraints we can green-light the LOI. I’ll ask legal to fast-track a small amendment for the SLO credit clause so we can attach it to the LOI.

-Aditya
CFO, Redwood Inference
